_comment: CloudWatch agent config. EC2 publishes CPU, network and disk I/O for free,
but not memory or disk usage — the hypervisor cannot see inside the guest.
On a 2 GB instance shared by a JVM, PostgreSQL and nginx, memory is the
most likely thing to go wrong, so it is worth the two custom metrics.
Two metrics sits well inside the 10 that are always free.
Install: sudo dnf install -y amazon-cloudwatch-agent, then
